name: Print I Love U
summary:
"A few weeks ago I came across a second hand laptop. The previous owner had disappeared.

On it, I found this game: Print I Love U. It's a short visual novel with three simple mini-games. Reaching the end takes about 15 minutes. It’s got hand-drawn characters and an original soundtrack that’s been living in my head rent-free since the first time I played it.

At the beginning, there's a note. It says the game was made for someone called Alice. It says: I hope you find this.

I've been trying to find her too.

I don't know who made this game. I don't know who Alice is. What I do know is that something about it stays with you, whether you want it to or not.

There's more than one ending. Not all of them feel like endings.

If you're Alice (or if you think you might know her) please tell me. Maybe you can solve this mystery."

This game may include content that is not suitable for all ages.
